independentFindings.finding: AraLearn is sufficiently mature to serve as a semantic and functional predecessor, but not as a physical module template.
independentFindings.resolution: Audit separates preserved contracts/fixtures from files and provider-specific organization.

independentFindings.finding: The draft backlog is intentionally broader than any feasible first implementation scope.
independentFindings.resolution: Every item remains non-executable and unprioritized until owner review.

independentFindings.finding: Issue 6–8 baselines previously used normative language although the owner remains in brainstorming.
independentFindings.resolution: This draft treats them as versioned conceptual inputs subject to discussion, not implementation authority.

independentFindings.finding: Twelve wireframes do not visually cover all 37 screen contracts.
independentFindings.resolution: They cover the principal interaction families; remaining screens are described textually and can receive drawings after review.

independentFindings.finding: Current cloud quotas and pricing are temporally unstable.
independentFindings.resolution: Technology document records access date and requires re-verification before decision.

limitations: No usability study or owner review has occurred.
No prototype or technology benchmark was executed.
Repository analysis prioritized authoritative documents and central implementation files rather than line-by-line review of every file.
External comparisons are architectural references, not proof that their models fit ARA.
Wireframes specify hierarchy and controls, not final aesthetics or accessibility conformance.
